_doc: NI-8 GOAP-lite (realm/minds.gd _plan_*, sim/utility_core.gd plan). Facts are bits the character's state is tested against; an action is [pre, add, del, cost] over facts, cost in minds.gd work units (CHUNK_UNITS 14 a chunk). A plan template names the (at most 3) actions it may use and the facts it wants; utility_core.plan orders them and skips any already satisfied. `run` is the existing module call the step goes through (minds.gd _plan_run). `world` facts are read from the game each time, the others are remembered in the plan once a step achieves them. Template score = base + sum(weight x trait) (persona 0..1 traits), gates: farmer, min_age, max_age. `hidden` plans are secrets (secrets.gd) until someone learns of them. Commitment: starts at c0 + c_amb x ambition + c_disc x discipline (max 255), loses decay + decay_vol x volatility per day, +gain per step done, -fail per failed step, and the plan is dropped at or below QUIT.
